summary: A black-and-white cinema page for a typeface descended from a laser film-subtitling machine: a wall of 20 looping title-sequence videos, then one movie-themed specimen page per weight (Pulp Fiction, Schwarzenegger, Star Wars/Trek, technical film specs in Mono), each followed by a grid of film clips subtitled in GT Cinetype, ending with credits that roll like a film's.

instances.look: A 4×5 wall of square greyscale video loops: chemical-element tiles ('Au 79', 'Mo 42', 'Pb 82', 'Cr 24'), timecode counters ('81 00:00:03:09'), spinning and laser-drawn 'CINETYPE' logos, 'TELEPATH', 'HEADACHE', 'EVOL', a spiralling burst, all over grainy landscape footage
instances.feel: Retro sci-fi opening titles, analogue film grain
instances.ux: Nothing to click; all tiles autoplay muted. A tiny speaker button at the left edge (fixed) plays a looping soundtrack. Before the page, a loader video shows an old TV in a dark room reading 'PLEASE WAIT'
instances.learn: A mosaic of short title-sequence loops shows a font across many moods at once: each tile is a tiny film title card

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed grid, 4 columns × 5 rows of 360×360px tiles (1440×1800, two viewports), no gaps; each tile a video with object-fit cover
reconstruction.typography: Inside the videos: GT Cinetype Regular/Light/Italic at ~60–120px in tile scale, outline and laser-line renderings, small timecodes ~20px
reconstruction.behaviour: 20 <video autoplay muted loop playsinline> tiles; loaded only on non-touch devices (lazysizes conditional include 'animation-grid.html (desktop), gifs.html' swaps in GIFs on touch); loader video #yopleasewait ~4s; #pButton toggles an <audio loop> soundtrack
reconstruction.content: Sci-fi words, element symbols with atomic numbers, film timecodes, the family name
reconstruction.assets: 20 square 400px H.264 loops (grain, nature footage, laser-line type), loader video, MP3 soundtrack

instances.look: A white band with three short columns of small dark text: the Cinetype company, the interpretation, the obsolescence of laser subtitling
instances.feel: Quiet pause after the video wall, like a film programme note
instances.learn: After a loud hero, a white strip of three small columns is enough to tell the origin; the contrast makes it read like a printed note

reconstruction.layout: Full-width white band ~246px tall; three columns at x≈50, 520, 990, each ~420px wide, top-aligned
reconstruction.typography: ~18px GT Cinetype Regular, leading ~1.4, dark grey on white
reconstruction.content: Real history: Swiss company Cinetype, laser that erased the film's coloured layer to set subtitles; designers Mauro Paolozzi and Rafael Koch

instances.look: Four black specimen pages, one per style pair, each labelled at top-left ('GT Cinetype Light / Italic — Pulp Fiction', 'Regular / Italic — Arnold Schwarzenegger', 'Bold / Italic — Star Wars / Star Trek', 'Mono — Technical specifications and statistics'): a giant quote ('BRING OUT THE GIMP', 'Right? Wrong!', 'MAY THE FORCE BE WITH YOU', 'CinemaScope'), a subtitled film clip beside a second size, then a paragraph and small text; the Mono page swaps the clip for a top-10 box-office table and film-format specs
instances.learn: Give each weight its own film genre and quote it at five fixed sizes: the series doubles as a family overview and a size waterfall, and the Mono page proves itself with tabular numbers

reconstruction.layout: Each page ~1600–2000px tall: 10px label at x=24,y=24; size0 line(s) full width from x=24; then a two-column row: square video ~690px at x=24 and text column from x≈740 (size1 or size3 list); then size2 paragraph full width; Mono page: size0 then size1 left + size2 right, table left + numbered spec list right
reconstruction.typography: size0 234–360px (Light 'BRING OUT', Regular 'Right?' 360px, Bold 'MAY THE FORCE…' 243px uppercase, Mono 'CinemaScope' 189px); size1 ~120px; size2 ~64px; size3 dialogue ~28px; size4 Mono specs ~14px; italics mixed in mid-line ('THE GIMP', 'Wrong!', 'you drink beer', 'the final frontier'); label 10px Regular
reconstruction.behaviour: One <video autoplay muted loop> per page (GIF fallback on touch); no scroll effects
reconstruction.content: Famous film quotes per weight, a Pulp Fiction dialogue transcript, a box-office top 10 (Avatar $2,787,965,087…), CinemaScope and Zeiss ƒ/1:3 specs with circled numbers
reconstruction.assets: Greyscale subtitled film clips (MP4 + GIF) for each page
